entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Aren't we going to the Palace?
entries.uk: Хіба ми не йдемо в Палац?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I'd like to know what your[n]plans are for today.
entries.uk: Хотілося б знати, які[n]в тебе плани на сьогодні.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Well, what do you want to do? Should we[n]meet up at the hideout and head into[n]the Palace?
entries.uk: Ну, що хочеш робити? Зберемося[n]в схованці й підемо в Палац?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: All right. I'll head over[n]to the hideout immediately.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: You should gather everyone[n]once you have a plan.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: In the meantime, I'll[n]do some work at the[n]student council room.
entries.uk: А поки я попрацюю[n]в кімнаті[n]учнівської ради.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Come by if you need anything.
